description:
Engineers at Heart, Connected to the Soil

We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, and AI practitioners with a very strong technical background and a deep respect for our roots. We grew up in the UAE, and we know what it takes to preserve our land.
summary:
**StrataSky** is a consumer-grade agricultural decision platform built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Dubai (*Field Shift*). Designed for the UAE’s hyper-arid climate, it pairs live NASA satellite telemetry—Langley POWER air temperature and solar irradiance, SMAP soil moisture, and ECOSTRESS evapotranspiration—with UAE Union Soil Atlas salinity data to generate low-water 3-year crop rotation plans.

Growers can explore pre-calibrated hubs like Al Ain Oasis and the ICBA Biosaline Hub, or click any valid UAE farmland or open desert parcel, protected by strict geofencing that blocks airports, roads, and industrial zones. StrataSky compares multi-tier **Oasis Shade** rotations (cutting water consumption by 60%) against salt-tolerant **Biosaline** cycles using Desert Quinoa and *Salicornia*.

Engineered with a high-contrast light UI for outdoor visibility, the platform includes full English and Arabic (`EN / عربي`) support, plain-language `?` metric tooltips, a Gemini AI Soil Advisor, and a tactile Slide-to-Export CSV tool.
details:
StrataSky is a consumer-grade agricultural decision-support web platform built by Team StrataSky for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Dubai (Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data). Aligned with the UAE National Food Security Strategy, the application translates complex NASA Earth observation telemetry into clear, low-water 3-year crop rotation plans tailored for farms, oases, and arid land across all seven Emirates.

Orbital Data & UAE Ground-Truth Calibration

  • NASA Langley POWER: Streams daily 2-meter air temperature (°C) and all-sky downward solar irradiance (MJ/m²/day) to calculate heat stress and surface evaporation rates.
  • NASA SMAP & ECOSTRESS: Tracks top-5cm volumetric soil moisture (%) alongside annual reference evapotranspiration (ET₀ in mm/yr), atmospheric CO₂ concentration (ppm), and carbon sink potential (t CO₂/ha/yr).
  • Local UAE Scientific Datasets: Cross-references orbital telemetry with UAE Union Soil Atlas profiles (soil texture, salinity in dS/m, and macronutrient/micronutrient balances) and NCM monthly rainfall normals.
  • Pre-Calibrated Agricultural Hubs: Includes instant regional benchmarks for Al Ain Oasis, Al Dhaid Plains, Liwa Crescent, and the ICBA Biosaline Hub in Dubai.

3-Year Regenerative Crop Rotation Plans

  • Oasis Shade Method (Multi-Tier Agroforestry): Establishes date palms and nitrogen-fixing legumes in Year 1 to create a shaded microclimate, followed by understory citrus, pomegranate, and fig trees in Years 2–3—cutting annual water consumption by 60% (8,500 m³/ha versus 22,000 m³/ha for traditional forage grass).
  • Biosaline Crop Rotation (ICBA Dubai Validated): Rotates salt-tolerant crops including Desert Quinoa and Salicornia bigelovii over three years to thrive on brackish well water (>10 dS/m), bio-accumulate soil salts, and regenerate topsoil at 3,800 m³/ha.

Platform Architecture & Key Features

  • Consumer-First Light UI: Redesigned from a technical dark-mode HUD into a clean, high-contrast light interface (#FFFFFF background, SF Pro typography with inline rounded-square app icons, and #34C759 green accents) engineered for readability in bright outdoor field conditions.
  • 4-Column Farm Directory & Interactive Live Map: Lets users filter zones by Emirate, Soil Profile (Deep Sandy Loam, Hyper-Arid Dune, Alluvial Gravel, Saline Sand), Water Source (Historic Falaj, Brackish Well, Desalinated, Fossil Aquifer), and Crop Plan before transitioning into the interactive Leaflet/OpenStreetMap console.
  • Strict UAE Geofencing & Arable Zoning: Locks map boundaries and geocoding strictly to the UAE while filtering out airports, roads, industrial zones, urban landmarks, and open water so calculations run exclusively on valid farmland, oases, and open desert plots.
  • Plain-Language ? Explainer Tooltips: Attaches interactive circular ? badges to every telemetry card and tab to translate scientific satellite metrics into practical irrigation guidance.
  • Full Bilingual Support (EN / عربي): Provides instant switching between English and right-to-left Arabic across navigation, directory filters, telemetry labels, tooltips, and AI outputs.
  • Gemini AI Soil Advisor: Integrates an interactive PromptBar powered by gemini-2.5-flash-lite alongside a one-click AI Generate button that summarizes the active plot's live soil telemetry and answers follow-up questions in English or Arabic.
  • Slide-to-Export CSV: Features a tactile SlideCommit slider synced to its completion animation to export parcel telemetry and 3-year rotation schedules into an offline CSV file for field crews.
